description: Causes, key events, and consequences of World War I and World War II

causes.militarism: European powers built up massive armed forces
causes.alliances: Triple Entente (France, UK, Russia) vs Triple Alliance (Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy)
causes.nationalism: Pan-Slavic movements and ethnic tensions in the Balkans
causes.trigger: Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary in Sarajevo, June 28, 1914

key_battles.Gallipoli: 1915–1916; failed Allied attempt to open route through Ottoman Empire

consequences.treaty_of_versailles: Imposed harsh reparations on Germany; sowed seeds of WWII
consequences.new_nations: Poland, Czechoslovakia, Yugoslavia, Finland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania formed

causes.rise_of_fascism: Nazi Germany under Hitler, Fascist Italy under Mussolini
causes.appeasement: Western powers' failed policy of conceding to Hitler's demands

theaters.western_europe: Fall of France (1940), Battle of Britain, D-Day Normandy (June 6, 1944)
theaters.eastern_front: Largest theater; Operation Barbarossa, Battle of Stalingrad
theaters.pacific: Pearl Harbor (December 7, 1941), island-hopping campaign, atomic bombs on Japan
theaters.north_africa: Desert campaign; El Alamein turning point

holocaust.description: Systematic genocide of 6 million Jews and millions of others by Nazi Germany
holocaust.methods: Concentration camps, death camps (Auschwitz, Treblinka, Sobibor)
holocaust.other_victims: Roma, disabled people, LGBTQ+, Slavs, political opponents

key_turning_points: Battle of Stalingrad (1942–1943): German defeat on Eastern Front
Battle of Midway (1942): US crippled Japanese naval power
D-Day (1944): Allied liberation of Western Europe begins
world_war_2.outcome: Allied victory; Germany surrenders May 8, 1945 (V-E Day); Japan surrenders September 2, 1945

consequences.nuclear_age: Atomic bombs dropped on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, August 1945
consequences.cold_war: US and USSR emerged as superpowers in ideological conflict
consequences.decolonization: Wave of independence movements in Africa and Asia
